answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, re-queued for a second panel. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The vault of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Work waits on the dune until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lagoon of the next round.
